title: Member Services Desk Manual, E.9 — Billing the Level Plan True-Up on a Refined Fuels Account
content:
At the close of a plan year on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts the desk settles the level plan against what the member actually used and puts the result onto the account as a single true-up line among the instalments billed there. A positive figure is added to what the member owes and a negative figure is credited to them; the member sees one extra line on the plan statement and the balance owed moves by exactly that figure.

## Billing the line

The true-up is billed with `bill_budget_plan_reconciliation_cfd56d13`, which the agent unlocks and then calls. The desk works the figure out and passes it in already formed; the tool aggregates no history and prices nothing.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `energy_account_id` | The internal reference number identifying the refined fuels or propane account whose budget plan is being trued up, as returned by the energy account lookup |
| `reconciliation_amount_usd` | The true-up figure, in USD to 2 decimal places, passed as a decimal number which is positive where the member is billed and negative where the member is credited, rounded half to even to 2 decimal places on the way in |

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the reference of the true-up line written, the plan month it was billed for as YYYY-MM, and the figure billed or credited in USD to 2 decimal places. Receiving that sentence is what indicates the true-up line now stands among the instalments on the account.

### Contract questions

**Which plan month does the line carry?** The plan month the desk works the true-up out in.

**Is a credit written as a separate kind of line?** No. One call writes a single true-up line, and its sign is what distinguishes a billing from a crediting.
